sql.scheduleType.getTypesForCompany: select id, company_id, schedule_type, archived from flow.schedule_type where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true
sql.scheduleType.getType: select id, company_id, schedule_type, archived from flow.schedule_type where id = :id
sql.scheduleType.deleteType: update flow.schedule_type set archived = true where id = :id
sql.scheduleType.updateType: update flow.schedule_type set schedule_type = :scheduleType where id = :id
